notes.title: _turing ver.1.2.0 アップデートのお知らせ
notes.notes: [p]Thank you very much for playing _turing![/p][p]We have released an update to version 1.2.0.[/p][p]Below are the main changes included in this update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Input limit during conversations relaxed to 30 characters[/h3][p]To further enhance the player experience, we have increased the input character limit during conversations from 20 to 30 characters.[/p][p][/p][h3]Increased response volume from AI-ris[/h3][p]AI-ris will now speak more extensively during conversations, providing a richer interaction.[/p][p][/p][h3]Revised content in the 5D branching scenario[/h3][p]We have reviewed and adjusted scenarios with low completion rates to improve their content.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other minor adjustments[/h3][p]We made various small fixes, including adding more hint elements.[/p][p][/p][p]Please note that with this update, dialogue may not function properly in versions earlier than v1.1.0.[/p][p]We recommend enjoying the game with the latest version.[/p][p][/p][p]More updates are planned in the future.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of _turing![/p]

notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.notes: We fixed the content of the questions in a certain part of this game to adjust the difficulty level.
